text.p: Comprehensive Environmental Systems Inc said Tuesday its action against Spartan Dismantling has been settled and the company will recognize a recovery of writeoffs it had previously posted.
Comprehensive said it received the $300,000 and the return to the company of 20,000 common shares sought.

It said the cash will be in the form of a downpayment of $25,000, with the remainder payable in monthly payments of $6,000 at an interest rate of 8.25 percent per annum. The note is fully collateralized by a first mortgage position on property located at Spartan's transfer facility in the New York City borough of Brooklyn.
This settlement came effective on Oct. 31, the end of the company's second fiscal quarter, it added.
